capabilities.description: Defines and validates the track schema that domain packs are authored against: terms, weeks, readings, cases, deliverables, session modes, weights, rubric and grade bands. All program content lives in YAML and is read at run time with no hardwiring in code, no stubs and no canned returns.
requirements: track schema with terms/weeks/readings/cases/deliverables

All program content (track names, themes, readings, cases, questions, deliverables) must live in YAML domain packs read at run time — no hardwiring in code, no stubs or canned returns, serves any program (COO, CEO, future tracks)
Ships with coo.v1 and ceo.v1 domain packs (16 weeks, 9 hours/week, weights 60/20/20, bands A 90 B 80 C 70)
pytest suites red-first-then-green for schema

6-session week calendar computed from an enrolment start date
5x20 rubric with letter bands
weighted gradebook
seven faculty session modes assembled into self-contained session/defense/jury prompts
Markdown export, JSON backup/restore
pytest suites red-first-then-green for calendar, rubric, prompts

token-based light/dark theming
sticky program bar and tab strip
localStorage persistence in try/catch

capabilities.description: Enforces the content/code separation: the generator refuses with ToolSpecError when a view string embeds content from the data block, the lint function returns one finding per contract line, and a grep test proves no program content is hardwired.
requirements: The generator must refuse (ToolSpecError) when a view string embeds content from the data block (no-hardwiring check)
a lint function returns one finding per contract line
a no-hardwiring grep test
pytest suites red-first-then-green for generator/lint

capabilities.description: Regenerates a file functionally equal to the owner's exec-programs.html and proves the lint contract holds, returning zero findings on both the regenerated file and the original.
requirements: Reference build: regenerate a file functionally equal to the owner's exec-programs.html, with lint returning zero findings on both the regenerated file and the original

It serves program owners, faculty, and participants across any track (COO, CEO, future programs) without hardwiring content in code, delivering session prompts, defense and jury materials, weighted gradebooks, and portable Markdown/JSON exports.
